title: AKGEC MCA First Year Fee Waiver Structure 2026-27
text:
AKGEC MCA First Year Fee Waiver Scheme 2026-27.
This is the MCA Fee Waiver (FW) fee, not the regular MCA fee.
Total college fee under Fee Waiver Scheme: Rs. 34814.
Registration Fee: Rs. 1500.
Development Fee: Rs. 10114.
Medical Charges: Rs. 1500.
Book Bank Fees: Rs. 3200.
Activity Fee (One Time): Rs. 5000.
PDP Charges: Rs. 3500.
Refundable Caution Money: Rs. 5000.
Career Planning and Placement (One Time): Rs. 5000.
Separate University Examination Fee: Rs. 7500.
Separate University Digital Library Fee: Rs. 700.
University charges are payable separately when demanded.
Counselling deposit must be deducted from the college fee.
Fees are subject to change.
